description.value:
Wolf Rider · уровень 15

Your bond turns instinct into protection.
Favored Bond: When your wolf is about to be reduced to
0 Hit Points or killed, you can expend one use of your
Favored Enemy to change its Hit Points to be 1 instead or prevent it from dying. (No action required).
Pack Cover: While Concentrating on Hunter’s Mark, you and your wolf have the benefits of Half Cover.

Автоматизация / ограничения:

  • Спутник и масштабирование — макрос управления. Условные совместные атаки, Help/Dodge, защита рядом и перехват смерти — вручную.

source.custom: Raiders of the Serpent Sea: Heroes’ Handbook
